summary.text: Jarvis Caldwell, a Republican, has represented District 20 in the Colorado House of Representatives since January 2025 and is the House Minority Leader.

paragraphs.text: According to Ballotpedia, he advanced from the June 30, 2026 Republican primary and is on the November 3, 2026 ballot for re-election.

Caldwell served in the U.S. Air Force from 2009 to 2019 and holds associate degrees from the Community College of the Air Force (2015 and 2017) and a bachelor's degree from American Military University (2022).
His career experience includes working as a nonprofit executive director, charter school board vice chairman, and Colorado House of Representatives communications director.
